author: Afro-Latino Education & Arts Collective
title: Commission seeking Black Puerto Rican female illustrator
content: Tag a Black Puerto Rican female illustrator. 🇵🇷🎨 PLEASE READ BEFORE SUBMITTING: As the Afro-Latino Education & Arts Collective, part of our mission is creating intentional opportunities for Black-identifying Latino artists and creatives. This particular commission is specifically seeking a Black-identifying Puerto Rican female illustrator. Puerto Rican heritage alone does not meet the criteria for this particular commission. Having African ancestry or Black relatives is also not the same as personally identifying as Black. We ask that applicants please respect the specificity of this opportunity so that space intentionally created for Black Puerto Rican female artists remains available to Black Puerto Rican female artists. Thank you for respecting the intention of the commission.

author: HappeningInMCR / Cultureword
title: Looking for digital artists for collaborative commission
content: Collaboration Commission with @cultureword. We’re looking for 6 North-West based digital storytelling partnerships (each comprised of 1 writer and 1 digital artist) to explore these questions in a co-created original piece of creative work. Forms you could work in include, but are not limited to: gaming, animation, film, narrative-based websites or social media pages, apps, audio fiction, transmedia storytelling. Successful partnerships will be awarded £800 (£400 per creative) to develop their idea. Final pieces will be displayed during Cultureword’s Creative Lock-In (27th November 2026). Deadline 7th October. Link: https://cultureword.org.uk/job-opportunities/merge-collaborative-commission-2026/
